data.name: Habeekah
data.gender_notes: Habeekah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'haba' which means 'to give' or 'to give as a gift'. In Islamic culture, it is believed that every child is a precious gift from Allah. Thus, the name Habeekah symbolizes the idea of a child being a blessing and a gift from Allah. The name Habeekah carries the meaning “Gift, Present” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Habeekah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, present and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Habeekah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Present.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Habeekah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
